payload.title: Synthetic Data
payload.description: This notebook generates synthetic data for comparison and sensitivity tests in KDE plots. It substitutes real data with AR(1) noise and introduces synthetic events of specified magnitudes. The process involves sorting data by latitude, fitting an AR(1) model, and generating surrogate values.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries and load preprocessed series and ensemble dictionaries from pickle files.
steps.title: Import Libraries and Load Data

steps.description: Sort the data by latitude to prepare for synthetic data generation.
steps.title: Sort Data by Latitude

steps.description: Define a function to add a synthetic spike to a series, which will be used to introduce synthetic events.
steps.title: Define Spike Function

steps.description: Set a signal to noise ratio for the synthetic data generation process.
steps.title: Set Signal to Noise Ratio
